nocmar.m: Hello and welcome to my place.
r: This place looks like a smithy. Do you have anything to trade?

nocmar_alkapoan_unknown_10.m: You've not been to Brimhaven and had to deal with him?

nocmar_alkapoan_unknown_20.m: Oh, then you must do so first as I need you to understand the man before you can accomplish what it is that I need from you.

nocmar_bladeBreaker_10.m: A parrying weapon it is. This will hinder your attacker's weapon.

nocmar_bladeBreaker_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_claymore_10.m: The bellows heave and the dragon's breath draws down into the furnace. I fold the heartstone's cooled core into the molten vein and shape the claymore. The metal sings to the hammer. Stand back while I temper and finish it.

nocmar_claymore_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it. And tell no one where you got this.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_complete.m: So you truly have it? The heartstone...beautiful and intact. Remarkable. You've done what few would dare. Can you see the glow? It's literally pulsating.

nocmar_complete_2.m: He studies it with reverence, then grows troubled.

nocmar_complete_3.m: But no, I cannot work it here. Too many eyes, too many whispers. If I were caught forging heartsteel in this shop, it would mean ruin for me. I need a place that is safe, hidden, yet...proper. Somewhere I can work without Lord Geomyr's men breathing down my neck. A place where I am allowed to be.

nocmar_complete_4.m: While pausing, Nocmar looks down, then sighs.

nocmar_complete_5.m: There was a time, before all this, when I had a place. A house. Not just any house...a white house on the edge of Fallhaven, glowing as if lit by the gods themselves. That glow comes from the forge inside. A forge unlike any other, always hot, always ready. It was there that I forged heartsteel in secret, while the shopfront stayed clean for coin and trade.
r: Well, that time has come back! I have the deed and the key to your forge house. [hand them to Nocmar]

nocmar_continue.m: Have you found a heartstone yet?
r: Yes, at last I found it.
Could you tell me the story again?
Actually, I found two. [extend your hands, one stone in each]
Yes, at last I found it.
[while shaking your head] It's in your hand.

nocmar_continue_2.m: Please keep looking. Unnmir must have something important planned for you.

nocmar_dagger_10.m: I work the heartstone down to a keen edge fit for a dagger. The heartsteel takes to a small shape with a bitter bite. This will be a precise and deadly blade.

nocmar_dagger_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_deed_receive_10.m: Meet me at the white house south of town. The lock will no longer bar your entry. I must prepare the forge and make certain the place is safe.

nocmar_dragon_reveal_10.m: Below this floor lies more than stone and ash. A dragon slumbers beneath, bound by the magic of this place since long before my time. Its breath seeps upward through cracks in the rock, feeding the forge with endless heat.

nocmar_dragon_reveal_10a.m: Even when no fire burns, the stones themselves glow with its warmth. The light you see spilling from under the door isn't flame - it's the dragon's breath, alive and eternal. I sealed the forge years ago when Geomyr banned heartsteel, but the glow never faded. It's as if the creature dreams in embers.
r: That explains the glow under the door?
A dragon? You've been living above a dragon?

nocmar_dragon_reveal_15.m: Aye. The forge's light is fed by its breath, not by any flame of mine.

nocmar_dragon_reveal_17.m: Aye. Respect it and it respects us. Disturb it and you wake things that cannot be bargained with. That is why I will work here and not in my shop.

nocmar_dragon_reveal_20.m: Now, you brought one cooled heartstone. We can forge only one item from it.

nocmar_forge_10.m: There you are. The forge has been lit. Truth be told, it never truly dies, not while the thing below sleeps. Come, sit by the anvil if you can steady your hands.

nocmar_forge_one_item_10.m: Heartsteel answers to shape and intent. Tell me which form you demand and I will pour the heartstone's essence into that blade or head. Choose wisely; only one may be made from this stone.
r: What?! I only get one? But how will I decide which one I want?

nocmar_forge_one_item_20.m: Oh, that's easier than you might think. Here, I will show you a list of the items and their capabilities. Then after you think about it, you can come back to me and I will forge it for you.
r: Very well. Let us see this list.

nocmar_forge_one_item_picked_10.m: Excellent. Which one do you desire?
r: Of course, I will take the one-handed sword.
I want that powerful great axe.
I really want that parrying weapon.
I adventure without a weapon, so I desire none of these.

nocmar_glaive_10.m: A glaive demands balance and spring. I ring the shaft and bind the heartsteel head to it, coaxing a reach that will cut through ranks.

nocmar_glaive_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_greateaxe_10.m: A great axe needs weight and a true center. I work the heartsteel into a ferocious head, then temper it in the dragon-warmed coals.

nocmar_greateaxe_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_handaxe_10.m: The hand axe will be compact and reliable. I shape the edge and set the haft so it fits your grip like a second thought.

nocmar_handaxe_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_mace_10.m: A mace it is. I imbue the head to carry both blunt force and uncanny true weight. This will crush bone and resolve alike.

nocmar_mace_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_no_weapon_10.m: Are you sure that I can't provide you a nice weapon?
r: Umm, no, I am not so sure. Maybe I do want one.

nocmar_onehanded_10.m: A one-handed war blade, balanced and quick. Heartsteel will make it sing in your hand and cleave with a will of its own.

nocmar_onehanded_20.m: It is done. The weapon cools beneath my hand. Take it, and guard it well. There will never be another like it.
r: Thank you. I will guard it.

nocmar_post_heartsteel_10.m: This place is a mess, I have a lot of work ahead of me to make this place usable.

nocmar_quest.m: Unnmir sent you huh? I guess it must be important then.

nocmar_quest_1.m: OK, these old weapons have lost their inner glow now that they haven't been used in a while.

nocmar_quest_2.m: To make the heartsteel glow again, we will need a heartstone.

nocmar_quest_3.m: Years ago, we used to fight the liches of Undertell. I have no idea if they still haunt the place.
r: Undertell? Is that where I could find a heartstone?

nocmar_quest_4.m: Undertell; the pits of the lost souls. Travel south to the devastated wastelands of Galmore Mountain and follow the tracks from there.

nocmar_quest_4a.m: Undertell; the pits of the lost souls. Travel south to the devastated wastelands of Galmore Mountain and follow the tracks from there.

nocmar_quest_5.m: Beware the liches of Undertell, if they are still around. Those things can kill you by their gaze alone.

nocmar_trade_1.m: I don't have any items for sale. I used to have a lot of things for sale, but nowadays I'm not allowed to sell anything.

nocmar_trade_2.m: I was once one of the greatest smiths in Fallhaven. Then that bastard Lord Geomyr banned my use of heartsteel.

nocmar_trade_3.m: By decree of Lord Geomyr, no one in Fallhaven is allowed to even use heartsteel weapons. Much less sell any.

nocmar_trade_4.m: So now I have to hide the few weapons I have left. I won't dare sell any of them anymore.

nocmar_trade_4_1.m: I haven't seen the heartsteel glow in several years now that Lord Geomyr has banned them.

nocmar_trade_5.m: So, unfortunately I can't sell you any of my weapons.

nocmar_two_stones_10.m: Well, I can tell from here that the one in your right hand is not ready. It is unrefined. Still forming. No heartsteel can be forged from this. If you tried, the forge would sputter and crack.

nocmar_two_stones_11.m: Return it back where you found it, it will continue drawing heat and pressure from the Rift, hardening over years. But taken from its cradle? It will never become whole. You must return it to the exact place you found it.
r: What about this other one? [showing Nocmar the stone in your left hand]

nocmar_unrefined_stone_10.m: Well, I can tell from here that it is unrefined. Still forming. No heartsteel can be forged from this. If you tried, the forge would sputter and crack. Return it back where you found it, it will continue drawing heat and pressure from the Rift, hardening over years. But taken from its cradle? It will never become whole. You must return it to the exact place you found it.

nocmar_wh_10.m: Ah, all these years and at last I have a chance to see it again.

nocmar_white_house_10.m: Yes, but I lost it. When Geomyr banned heartsteel, my gold dried up. I went to Alkapoan for a loan. Fool that I was, I could not repay him, and so he took the house...my house...as his prize. He holds the deed, and he holds the key.
r: That's a lot to lose, indeed.

nocmar_white_house_20.m: If I am to work again, I must have that house returned to me. Speak to Alkapoan. Persuade him, pay him, bargain with him. Do what must be done. Bring me the deed and the key, and only then shall I forge for you once more.
r: This is exciting. I will not let you down.

nocmar_white_house_forget_alkapoan_10.m: You've not been to Brimhaven and had to deal with him?
r: Oh, the rich guy up on his high hill? I remember now.

place_to_forge.10: Nocmar refused to forge heartsteel in his shop, fearing discovery by Geomyr's men. He revealed that he once owned a glowing white house south of Fallhaven, where a special forge still burns. That forge was the only place he ever worked heartsteel. But after falling into debt, he lost the house to Alkapoan. If Nocmar is to forge again, I must help him regain it.
place_to_forge.20: Nocmar told me that Alkapoan holds the deed and key to the glowing white house. He said the forge within never dies, always blazing, ready for work. If I can reclaim the deed and key from Alkapoan, Nocmar will finally have his forge back.
place_to_forge.30: Alkapoan scoffed when I mentioned Nocmar. He said the only way to reclaim the glowing white house is to pay him fifty thousand gold. Nothing else will satisfy him.
place_to_forge.35: I told Alkapoan I wanted the glowing white house for myself. He agreed to sell it for forty thousand gold, but only if I first complete a task for him to prove my worth.
place_to_forge.40: Alkapoan asked me to collect an overdue 'operation tax' of five thousand gold from a card dealer in the back room of Brimhaven's tavern. I'll need to go there and retrieve the gold for Alkapoan before he will sell me the deed to the white house for forty thousand.
place_to_forge.45: I was able to collect the overdue 'operation tax' from the dealer and now I should return to Alkapoan.
place_to_forge.50: After I paid Alkapoan, he gave me the deed and the key to the white house south of Fallhaven. I should bring them back to Nocmar.
place_to_forge.60: I was able to finally give Nocmar back what was rightfully his...possession of his forge house.

nocmar.10: Unnmir told me he used to be an adventurer, and gave me a hint to go see Nocmar. His house is just southwest of the tavern in Fallhaven.
nocmar.20:
Nocmar tells me he used to be a smith. But Lord Geomyr has banned the use of heartsteel, so he cannot forge his weapons anymore.
If I can find a heartstone and bring it to Nocmar, he should be able to forge the heartsteel again.
nocmar.30: Nocmar, the Fallhaven smith, said that I could find a heartstone in a place called Undertell which is somewhere near Galmore Mountain.
nocmar.35: Myrelis, the ghost artist I met in the Galmore encampment, informed me that the entrance to Undertell is located just southwest of his building.
nocmar.40: I discovered the heartstone deep inside Undertell, but it was far too hot to move or even touch. Maybe Unnmir knows what I should do next?
nocmar.45: I discovered a heartstone deep inside Undertell. It's time to put Nocmar to work.
nocmar.48: Nocmar informed me that I must return the unrefined heartstone back to where I found it so it could "become whole".
nocmar.50: Unnmir told me that the only way to cool the heartstone enough to carry it is to use a block of Galmore ice which he said I could find at the top of Galmore Mountain guarded by the snow beasts. This rare ice does not melt in the lowlands, only when placed against something extremely hot like lava or the heartstone itself.
nocmar.60: I was spooked by a sound causing me to lose my grip on the unrefined heartstone, causing me to drop it. Thus shattering it into pieces.
nocmar.70: I placed the Galmore ice on the heartstone. The block hissed and steamed as it melted away, cooling the heartstone until it was safe to touch. I picked it up at last.
nocmar.80: I returned to Nocmar with the cooled heartstone. He was eager to begin his work, but... not in his Fallhaven shop.
nocmar.90: Nocmar told me to meet him at the glowing white house south of Fallhaven. He says the lock will no longer bar my entry, as he must prepare the forge and make sure the place is safe.
nocmar.100: I met Nocmar inside the glowing white house, where the ever-burning forge waits. He explained that with the heartstone I recovered, he can forge one heartsteel weapon of my choice.
nocmar.110: As I refused a heartsteel weapon from Nocmar, Falkour, the forge dragon beneath the glowing house, gifted me a pendant.
nocmar.200: Nocmar forged the heartsteel once again and rewarded me with a weapon type of my choice, reforged in the lost art.

brv_flood.10: I found two not very bright brothers in a cellar of their house. They seemed to be talking about some sinister plan.
brv_flood.20: They were planning to destroy the great dam of Brimhaven. They just could not agree how they would do it.
brv_flood.30: They asked me to help them.
brv_flood.50: I have agreed to destroy the dam for them.
brv_flood.52: The brothers gave me a hand axe that could weaken the dam in a vulnerable place.
brv_flood.53: I took another hand axe. This time I shouldn't lose it.
brv_flood.54: I found the weak spot in the dam and started hacking at the wood.
brv_flood.56: Water came pouring through the hole in the dam. A lot of water!
brv_flood.70: I refused to destroy the dam for the brothers.
brv_flood.72: Given what I overheard, I was not allowed to leave. The two brothers attacked me.
brv_flood.80: Someone else destroyed the dam and water came pouring through a hole in the dam. A lot of water!
brv_flood.100: The Brimhaven guards have informed me that I may not leave the town until they have investigated who destroyed the dam.
brv_flood.110: I have promised to track down the real perpetrators. However, I still cannot leave the town.
brv_flood.120: The two brothers did not know their boss's name, but he seemed to have a lot of gold.
brv_flood.130: The rich man living up on the hill of Brimhaven seemed to know more than he admitted.
brv_flood.150: The rich man boasted that he had been bribed by an important man in Loneford to sabotage the dam.
brv_flood.200: I gave the letters as a piece of evidence to the captain of the guard. Now it is up to them to deal with the rich man.
